name: aloha-fyi-hawaii
description: First dedicated Hawaii tourism MCP server. Search 2,583 bookable tours and activities across all 4 islands, find 540+ curated restaurants in Waikiki and Oahu, check current weather and surf conditions, browse 579 upcoming events and festivals, get Groupon deals sorted by price, and plan full-day itineraries by island and vibe. Every result includes affiliate booking links. Powered by aloha.fyi — Hawaii's AI concierge serving visitors in 5 languages across the islands.

_published_faq.name: How do I add aloha-fyi-hawaii to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add aloha-fyi-hawaii to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-server-nani-v3-20.up.railway.app/mcp.
